subject: Request for a Meeting
body:
Dear Mr Tan,

I hope this message finds you well.

I would like to arrange a short meeting at your convenience to discuss matters relating to your account with us. Please let me know a date and time that would suit you, whether in person or by call, and I will make the necessary arrangements.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,

Your Relationship Manager
Julius Baer
